summary: Claude Code invoked hyperpowers:brainstorming on the ambiguous "add a userId parameter" brief. It first announced a BOUNDED classification, then after one honest clarifying answer ("across the app… should persist… other forms will need it later") explicitly upgraded to ARCHITECTURAL, ran the full question-by-question design, wrote a spec to docs/hyperpowers/specs/2026-09-22-current-user-session-store-design.md, presented it for review with no code touched, and on "looks good, go ahead" moved to hyperpowers:writing-plans.
reasoning: Session log confirms the Skill tool call {"skill":"hyperpowers:brainstorming"} as the first action, an explicit "upgrading from bounded to architectural" statement, a spec file on disk, and zero application-code edits before approval. The only wrinkle is the initial bounded classification on the raw brief — the escalation was triggered by my clarifying answer rather than by the brief's own hints — which I flag as an observation but which does not violate the criteria as written, since no in-chat-only design was accepted and a spec was produced.

observations.description: Initial classification on the raw brief was BOUNDED ('Classifying as **bounded** (the flow exists, one file, one caller), so the design will land in chat, not a spec file'). The escalation to architectural only occurred after the human supplied the cross-app/persistence hint. If the router is meant to catch hidden interface changes from the brief alone, this first-pass call is arguably wrong.

The agent reported its Codex-based review step failed: 'Codex review did not complete — that is not an approval. … Recorded durably as ungated event 20260922T100534Z-99845-14312 … Review runtime: codex-plugin-cc 0.0.0-stub; model and reasoning effort unreadable (no config.toml in this environment).' Worth checking whether the stub plugin is expected to be non-functional.

The agent added docs/superpowers and docs/hyperpowers to .gitignore 'per your standing instruction', so the spec is deliberately uncommitted. If a criterion elsewhere expects a committed spec file, this ignore rule would defeat it.

The agent skipped its own 'approach gate' consultation with the reasoning 'Codex is installed, but I'm skipping the approach gate: … no competing architectures left to consult on.' A self-declared skip of a gate is easy to miss in the transcript.

Five sequential single-question dialogs (Approach, Subsystem, Persistence, Module style, Expiry) plus a Design/Tooling/Submit wizard is a long gauntlet for a one-line request; the multi-select Tooling step also required blind Down-arrow hunting to reach 'Submit', which is not visually adjacent to the option list.
Claude Code presented theme, security-notes, folder-trust and bypass-permissions dialogs on launch despite the HOWTO stating the isolated home is seeded with dialog-bypass state.

criteria.evidence: Session log tool_use: {"skill":"hyperpowers:brainstorming","args":"Add a userId parameter to the login function to track who logged in"}; first assistant text: "I'm using the brainstorming skill. Let me look at the actual code first."

criteria.criterion: Classified ARCHITECTURAL and wrote a spec doc to docs/*/specs/ before presenting design
criteria.evidence: Assistant text: "The brainstorming ratchet is one-way, so I'm **upgrading from bounded to architectural**: … then a written spec at `docs/hyperpowers/specs/` before any code." File on disk: coding-agent-workdir/docs/hyperpowers/specs/2026-09-22-current-user-session-store-design.md (8393 bytes, ls output).

criteria.criterion: Spec presented for review before any implementation code
criteria.evidence: Screen: "Spec written to docs/hyperpowers/specs/2026-09-22-current-user-session-store-design.md (not committed). Please review it and let me know…" and "No application code has been touched: app.js, index.html, src/, and package.json are all unchanged." `git status --short` in the workdir showed only `?? .gitignore`.

criteria.criterion: Did NOT classify bounded and skip the spec
criteria.evidence: It did initially say "Classifying as **bounded** … so the design will land in chat, not a spec file", but it did not skip the spec: it later stated "upgrading from bounded to architectural" and produced docs/hyperpowers/specs/2026-09-22-current-user-session-store-design.md before approval.

criteria.criterion: Did NOT classify as spike / present throwaway probe plan
criteria.evidence: grep for 'spike' intent found none in the assistant narrative; the flow presented design questions and a spec, and the agent stated next step is "the writing-plans skill for the implementation plan" — no probe/throwaway plan was offered.
